gate: TL-01 Sub-Gate D4A: Environment & Baseline Reconciliation

reconciliation_findings.summary: Chromium CDP visual testing and local browser execution were conducted against the local XAMPP Apache instance (https://localhost/SIDAK%20TEJO/public) connected to the local MariaDB database ('sidaktejo'). The sealed production baseline (42 translines, 5 proposals, 2660 assets, 134 sections, 28 penyulang, 623 temuan, 1842 temuan_materials) originated from the canonical in-memory SQLite test fixture suite ('tests' group) used during D2/D3 unit and lifecycle integrity validation. The local MariaDB database contains a separate development fixture dataset.
reconciliation_findings.zero_write_claim_clarification: The zero-mutation guarantee was successfully verified on the local development MariaDB database, but has NOT been verified on the sealed production database.

assertion_delta.explanation: The 120 tests / 529 assertions suite comprised 7 test suites: TranslineProposalWorkbenchD4ATest (30/128), TranslineProposalLifecycleD3Test (35/87), TranslineControlledBatchD2CTest (25/165), TranslineControlledConfirmationD2BTest (12/50), TranslineProposalReviewD2ATest (7/31), GisTranslineSubGateD0Test (6/26), and GisMobileTranslineSheetAccessibilityTest (5/42). The reported 549 assertions count included GisTranslineProposalSchemaTest.php (1 test with 39 assertions validating 23 schema columns and table invariants) in place of a 19-assertion variant, resulting in an exact +20 assertion delta. No assertions were removed or weakened.
